{{Quote|Says here, nine years ago, before Jenkes joined the Imperial service, he managed a gladiator arena on the planet Nyriaan.|The bounty hunter [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] discovers information concerning Jenkes time at the arena|<ref name="EG" />}}
A '''gladiatorial arena''' was built on the [[planet]] [[Nyriaan]]. During the early [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Era|reign]] it was managed by the [[human]] [[Jenkes]].<ref name="EG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The arena was first mentioned in ''[[Ezra's Gamble]]'', a novel written by [[Ryder Windham]] and released in [[2014]].<ref name="EG" />
